newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV up as market slowly digests strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: OMV up as market slowly digests strong Q1.

text.p: Shares in oil firm OMV climbed 1.2 percent in Vienna on Wednesday, adding to the previous day's 3.56 percent gain, as investors bought in delayed response to strong first quarter earnings posted at the start of the week.
At 0905 GMT OMV shares were 16.6 schillings up at 1,403 on heavy volume of 42,393 contracts -- advancing towards the year high of 1,443 schillings.
"OMV presented super results on Monday and that triggered buying today and yesterday from investors at home and abroad," a Vienna trader said.
On Monday, OMV reported an 8.5 percent increase in first quarter earnings before interest and tax to 1.02 billion schillings and said it expected a good profit development for the full year.
Traders said the Austrian market had been slow to digest the figures with activity dampened on Monday by a holiday in Britain. -- Janet McBride, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
